title: 施工測量控制網~Construction surveying control networks
focus: 以誤差預算、坐標系統、穩定控制點與統計平差，讓放樣、貫通與監測都建立在可信的基準上~Error budgets, coordinate systems, stable control points and statistical adjustment that give set-out, breakthrough and monitoring a trustworthy reference
summary: 從控制網層級與精度預算出發，說明投影比例因子、觀測墩與強制對心、全測站與 GNSS 的精度規格與 ISO 17123 現場檢定，再處理導線與最小二乘平差、高層建築軸線垂直傳遞、GNSS 靜態測量與高程換算、長隧道貫通誤差，以及控制網複測、參考框架與交接紀錄，並以戈達基線隧道、英法海底隧道與 Crossrail 的公開資料對照。~Starting from network hierarchy and accuracy budgets, explain projection scale factors, pillars and forced centring, total-station and GNSS specifications with ISO 17123 field tests, then traverses and least-squares adjustment, vertical transfer of grid lines in tall buildings, static GNSS and height conversion, long-tunnel breakthrough error, and finally network re-survey, reference frames and handover records, compared with public data from the Gotthard Base Tunnel, the Channel Tunnel and Crossrail.

units.title: 控制網層級與精度預算~Control-network hierarchy and accuracy budget
units.mechanism: 施工測量的原則是先整體、後局部，先控制、後碎部：國家坐標框架提供絕對位置，專案主控制網以 GNSS 與精密全測站建立少數高精度點，再以導線加密成次級控制，最後才由工作點放樣柱位、錨栓與模板。每一層的誤差都會傳到下一層，所以控制網不是測得越多越好，而是先從結構允許的放樣公差倒推每一層可分配的誤差，再選擇儀器、網形與觀測次數。~Construction surveying works from the whole to the part and from control to detail: the national frame gives absolute position, the project's primary network establishes a few high-accuracy points by GNSS and precise total station, traverses densify it into secondary control, and only then do working points set out columns, anchor bolts and formwork. Errors at each level pass to the next, so a control network is not about measuring as much as possible but about working back from the structure's set-out tolerance to the error each level may consume, then choosing instruments, geometry and number of observations.
units.model: 放樣公差 ±10 mm（95%）對應總標準差 σ = 10/1.96 ≈ 5.1 mm。主控制網分配 σ_p = 2 mm、次級控制 σ_s = 3 mm，放樣作業可用 σ_o = √(5.1² − 2² − 3²) = √(26.0 − 4 − 9) = √13.0 ≈ 3.6 mm。若主控制只達 4 mm，σ_o = √(26.0 − 16 − 9) = 1.0 mm，現場幾乎無法達成。數值為教學假設。~A set-out tolerance of ±10 mm at 95% means a total standard deviation σ = 10/1.96 ≈ 5.1 mm. Allocating σ_p = 2 mm to primary control and σ_s = 3 mm to secondary control leaves σ_o = √(5.1² − 2² − 3²) = √(26.0 − 4 − 9) = √13.0 ≈ 3.6 mm for set-out. If primary control only reaches 4 mm, σ_o = √(26.0 − 16 − 9) = 1.0 mm, which is barely achievable on site. Values are teaching assumptions.
units.verify: 在測量計畫中列出每一層控制的精度目標與驗證方式：主控制網以最小二乘平差的誤差橢圓、次級導線以閉合差、放樣點以獨立檢核（由另一控制點或另一組人員重測）確認；三者合成後與結構及帷幕牆的公差規定比較。~The survey plan lists the accuracy target and check method for each level: error ellipses from the least-squares adjustment for primary control, misclosures for secondary traverses and independent checks for set-out points (re-measured from another control point or by another crew); the combined result is compared with the structural and façade tolerance requirements.
units.failure: 承包商只用一個控制點以單一極座標法放樣整個基地，沒有任何獨立檢核；控制點被機具撞動數公分後，整排錨栓隨之偏移，直到鋼柱吊裝時才發現對不上。~A contractor sets out the whole site by polar method from a single control point without any independent check; when plant knocks the point by a few centimetres the whole row of anchor bolts shifts with it, and the error is found only when steel columns will not fit at erection.
units.misconception: 只要用最精密的儀器，就不需要規劃控制網層級與誤差分配。~With the most precise instrument there is no need to plan network hierarchy or error allocation.
units.practice: 開工前提交測量計畫，列出控制點分布、儀器、觀測方法、精度目標與檢核頻率，交由業主的測量顧問審查；每一個放樣成果都必須有獨立檢核紀錄才可交付下一工序。~Before work starts submit a survey plan listing control-point layout, instruments, observation methods, accuracy targets and check frequency for review by the owner's survey consultant; every set-out result needs an independent check record before it is handed to the next trade.

units.anchor: 合併比例因子~Combined scale factor
units.title: 坐標系統、格網與地面比例~Coordinate systems, grid and ground scale
units.mechanism: 坐標格網是把地球曲面投影到平面的結果，格網距離與地面實際距離之間有比例差：橫麥卡托投影在中央經線處比例因子小於 1，離中央經線越遠越大；同時測站越高，地面距離歸算到橢球面後越短。兩者相乘的合併比例因子在長距離工程中可達每公里數十到上百公釐，因此長線形工程常建立低變形的專案坐標系，並在測量計畫中明定格網與地面距離的換算方式。~A coordinate grid is a projection of the curved Earth onto a plane, so grid distances differ from ground distances by a scale: on a transverse Mercator projection the scale factor is below 1 at the central meridian and grows with distance from it, while the higher the site, the shorter a ground distance becomes when reduced to the ellipsoid. Their product, the combined scale factor, can amount to tens or hundreds of millimetres per kilometre on long works, so linear projects often set up low-distortion project coordinate systems and the survey plan states how grid and ground distances are converted.
units.model: 台灣 TM2 投影中央經線 121°E、k₀ = 0.9999。距中央經線 50 km：k ≈ 0.9999×(1 + 50,000²/(2×6,371,000²)) ≈ 0.9999×1.0000308 ≈ 0.99993；高程 500 m 的高程因子 6,371,000/6,371,500 ≈ 0.999922。合併因子 ≈ 0.99993×0.999922 ≈ 0.999852，地面 1,000 m 對應格網 999.852 m，差約 148 mm。數值為教學假設。~Taiwan's TM2 projection has central meridian 121°E and k₀ = 0.9999. At 50 km from the meridian k ≈ 0.9999×(1 + 50,000²/(2×6,371,000²)) ≈ 0.9999×1.0000308 ≈ 0.99993; at 500 m elevation the height factor is 6,371,000/6,371,500 ≈ 0.999922. The combined factor ≈ 0.99993×0.999922 ≈ 0.999852, so 1,000 m on the ground is 999.852 m on the grid, about 148 mm less. Values are teaching assumptions.
units.verify: 在基地兩端的控制點之間以全測站直接量測地面距離，與由坐標反算的格網距離比較，差值應符合計算的合併比例因子；設計、測量與鋼構製造廠須確認使用同一套距離換算，並在圖說上標示坐標系統與比例處理方式。~Measure the ground distance between control points at the two ends of the site directly with a total station and compare it with the grid distance computed from coordinates; the difference should match the computed combined scale factor. Designers, surveyors and the steel fabricator must confirm they use the same distance conversion, and drawings must state the coordinate system and how scale is handled.
units.failure: 設計以格網坐標出圖，鋼構廠卻依圖上尺寸以地面長度製造，在長約 1 km 的高架或長廊上累積出十幾公分的長度差，最後幾跨的梁與支承對不上，只能現場切割或重新製造。~Design issues drawings in grid coordinates while the steel fabricator builds to ground lengths from the dimensions, so over a viaduct or concourse about 1 km long the length difference accumulates to more than 100 mm and the last spans' girders do not meet their bearings, forcing site cutting or refabrication.
units.misconception: 坐標反算的距離就是現場量到的實際距離。~The distance computed from coordinates equals the actual distance measured on the ground.
units.practice: 測量計畫要明定坐標系統、投影、高程基準與合併比例因子，長線形工程應評估是否採用低變形專案坐標；製造圖尺寸一律以地面尺寸標註，換算方法由測量主管簽認。~The survey plan must define the coordinate system, projection, height datum and combined scale factor, and for long linear works assess a low-distortion project grid; fabrication-drawing dimensions are always given as ground dimensions, with the conversion method signed off by the survey lead.

units.title: 控制點標石、觀測墩與穩定性~Monuments, pillars and point stability
units.mechanism: 控制網的精度不只取決於儀器，也取決於控制點本身是否穩定。主控制點常做成深入穩定地層的混凝土觀測墩，頂部埋設強制對心盤，讓儀器與稜鏡每次都安裝在同一點，消除對心誤差；地面標石則要避開開挖影響範圍、施工便道與排水路徑。觀測墩本身也會受日照溫差與地下水變化而微小移動，所以重要工程會在影響範圍外另設參考點，用來判斷控制點是否移動。~A network's accuracy depends not only on instruments but on whether the control points themselves are stable. Primary points are often concrete pillars founded in stable ground with forced-centring plates on top so that instrument and prism are mounted at exactly the same point every time, removing centring error; ground marks must avoid the zone of excavation influence, haul roads and drainage paths. Pillars also move slightly with solar heating and groundwater changes, so major works add reference points outside the zone of influence to judge whether control points have moved.
units.model: 對心誤差造成的角度誤差 ε = e/D。三腳架光學對心 e = 1 mm、後視距離 D = 50 m：ε = 0.001/50 = 20 µrad ≈ 4.1″；強制對心 e = 0.1 mm 時 ε ≈ 0.4″。以 4.1″ 的方向誤差放樣 200 m 外的點，橫向偏差 = 200×20×10⁻⁶ = 4.0 mm。數值為教學假設。~Angular error from centring ε = e/D. Optical tripod centring with e = 1 mm and a 50 m backsight gives ε = 0.001/50 = 20 µrad ≈ 4.1″; forced centring with e = 0.1 mm gives ε ≈ 0.4″. Setting out a point 200 m away with a 4.1″ direction error displaces it laterally by 200×20×10⁻⁶ = 4.0 mm. Values are teaching assumptions.
units.verify: 建立控制點時拍照並記錄點之記（位置描述、埋設深度、周邊參考），開工前及每次重大開挖或降水前後重測控制點之間的距離與高差，與初始值比較；觀測墩可在不同時段重複量測，評估日照造成的微小移動。~When establishing control points photograph them and write point descriptions (location sketch, founding depth, nearby references); re-measure distances and height differences between control points before work starts and before and after major excavation or dewatering, comparing with initial values, and repeat pillar observations at different times of day to assess small solar movements.
units.failure: 主控制點設在基坑邊的臨時圍籬旁，隨著開挖與降水緩慢沉陷並向坑內位移，測量人員仍把它當成不動點，連續數月的放樣全部帶著同一系統偏差，直到與遠處參考點檢核才發現。~A primary point placed beside the temporary hoarding at the edge of an excavation slowly settles and moves toward the pit with digging and dewatering, while surveyors still treat it as fixed; months of set-out carry the same systematic error until a check against a distant reference point reveals it.
units.misconception: 控制點一旦埋設完成，坐標就永遠不會改變。~Once a control point is installed, its coordinates never change.
units.practice: 控制點位置須由測量與大地工程人員共同選定，置於開挖影響範圍之外並加設保護；控制點遭碰撞或疑似移動時應立即停用並重新檢測，經測量主管確認後才能恢復使用。~Control-point locations should be chosen jointly by survey and geotechnical staff, outside the zone of excavation influence and protected; any point that is struck or suspected of moving must be withdrawn immediately and re-checked, returning to use only after the survey lead confirms it.

units.anchor: 全測站測距與大氣改正~Total-station EDM and atmospheric correction
units.title: 儀器精度規格與現場檢定~Instrument specifications and field testing
units.mechanism: 全測站以電子測距與角度編碼器量測，測距精度常寫成 a mm + b ppm：a 是與距離無關的固定誤差，b 是隨距離成比例的誤差。光波在空氣中的速度受溫度與氣壓影響，未做大氣改正時，溫度誤差約每 1°C 造成約 1 ppm 的距離誤差；稜鏡常數設錯則讓每個距離都帶固定偏差。ISO 17123 系列規定以簡易現場程序檢查全測站、水準儀與 GNSS 的實際重複精度，讓工地確認儀器在當天條件下仍適合任務。~A total station measures with electronic distance measurement and angle encoders, and distance accuracy is usually stated as a mm + b ppm: a is a fixed error independent of distance and b a proportional error. The speed of light in air depends on temperature and pressure, so without atmospheric correction a temperature error of about 1°C causes roughly 1 ppm of distance error, while a wrong prism constant puts a fixed offset on every distance. The ISO 17123 series sets simple field procedures to check the actual repeatability of total stations, levels and GNSS, so the site can confirm that an instrument still suits the task under the day's conditions.
units.model: 規格 ±(1 mm + 1 ppm) 在 400 m 時為 1 + 400×10⁻⁶×1,000 = 1.4 mm。若輸入溫度比實際低 5°C 而未改正，約 5 ppm×400 m = 2.0 mm，大於儀器本身誤差；稜鏡常數錯 30 mm（例如 −30 與 0 混用）則每個距離都偏 30 mm。數值為教學假設。~A ±(1 mm + 1 ppm) specification at 400 m gives 1 + 400×10⁻⁶×1,000 = 1.4 mm. Entering a temperature 5°C too low without correction adds about 5 ppm×400 m = 2.0 mm, more than the instrument's own error, and a prism constant wrong by 30 mm (for example mixing −30 and 0) offsets every distance by 30 mm. Values are teaching assumptions.
units.verify: 依 ISO 17123-5 在工地基線上以規定測回數量測，計算實驗標準差並與製造商規格比較；每天作業前檢查視準軸與指標差、稜鏡常數與大氣參數設定，儀器定期送校並保存校正證書。~Following ISO 17123-5, observe the prescribed number of sets on a site baseline, compute the experimental standard deviation and compare it with the manufacturer's specification; before each day's work check collimation and index errors, prism constant and atmospheric settings, and send instruments for periodic calibration with certificates kept on file.
units.failure: 儀器從冷氣車廂直接拿到烈日下使用而未等待溫度平衡，大氣參數又沿用前一天的設定，整天的距離帶著數 ppm 的偏差；混用不同廠牌稜鏡卻未改常數，放樣點系統性偏移數公分。~An instrument taken straight from an air-conditioned vehicle into strong sun without time to equilibrate, with atmospheric settings carried over from the previous day, biases a whole day's distances by several ppm; mixing prism brands without changing the constant shifts set-out points systematically by centimetres.
units.misconception: 儀器規格表上的精度，就是現場實際能達到的精度。~The accuracy on the instrument data sheet is what will be achieved on site.
units.practice: 測量作業程序應規定開工前的儀器現場檢定、每日檢查表、稜鏡與儀器配對清單及大氣量測方式；未通過檢定的儀器貼上停用標籤，經校正並由測量主管簽認後才能再用。~The survey procedure should require field tests before work starts, a daily checklist, a register pairing prisms with instruments and the method of atmospheric measurement; an instrument that fails is tagged out of service and returns only after calibration and sign-off by the survey lead.

units.anchor: 閉合導線與平差~Closed traverse and adjustment
units.title: 導線加密、網形平差與閉合差~Traverse densification, network adjustment and misclosure
units.mechanism: 主控制點之間距離較遠，施工需要的點要以導線或測站網加密：從已知點出發，逐站量測水平角與距離，最後閉合到另一已知點。閉合差反映整條導線的誤差累積並能顯示粗差；更嚴謹的做法是把所有觀測放入最小二乘網形平差，得到每個點的坐標、誤差橢圓與多餘觀測，並以統計檢定（例如資料探測）找出有問題的觀測。網形必須有足夠的多餘觀測，單一路徑的支導線無法檢查。~Primary points are far apart, so the points construction needs are densified by traverses or networks: starting from a known point, horizontal angles and distances are measured station by station, closing on another known point. The misclosure reflects the error accumulated along the traverse and reveals blunders; the more rigorous approach puts all observations into a least-squares network adjustment that gives coordinates, error ellipses and redundancy for every point, with statistical tests such as data snooping to find faulty observations. The network needs enough redundant observations, since a single open spur traverse cannot be checked.
units.model: 閉合導線周長 1,200 m，坐標閉合差 ΔE = +0.012 m、ΔN = −0.009 m，線性閉合差 = √(0.012² + 0.009²) = 0.015 m，相對精度 0.015/1,200 = 1/80,000。8 個測站的角度閉合差容許值若取 5″√n = 5×√8 ≈ 14″，實測 9″ 即合格。數值為教學假設。~A closed traverse 1,200 m long has coordinate misclosures ΔE = +0.012 m and ΔN = −0.009 m, so the linear misclosure is √(0.012² + 0.009²) = 0.015 m and the relative precision is 0.015/1,200 = 1/80,000. If the angular tolerance for 8 stations is 5″√n = 5×√8 ≈ 14″, a measured 9″ passes. Values are teaching assumptions.
units.verify: 平差報告需列出每個觀測的殘差、標準化殘差與多餘觀測分量，標準化殘差超過約 3 的觀測要追查；成果點誤差橢圓的長半軸須小於精度目標，並由另一組人員以不同路徑檢測少數關鍵點。~The adjustment report must list residuals, standardised residuals and redundancy numbers for every observation, and any standardised residual above about 3 is investigated; error-ellipse semi-major axes of the resulting points must be below the accuracy target, and a different crew re-checks a few key points by a different route.
units.failure: 為了趕工以多段支導線一路延伸到基地另一端，既無閉合也無檢核，某一站的後視點認錯導致後續所有點旋轉數十秒，偏差到最後一站已達數公分卻無人察覺。~Rushing, a crew extends a chain of open spur traverses to the far end of the site with no closure or check; a wrong backsight at one station rotates every later point by tens of seconds, and the error reaches several centimetres at the last station without anyone noticing.
units.misconception: 閉合差很小，就證明導線中沒有任何錯誤。~A small misclosure proves the traverse contains no errors.
units.practice: 控制加密一律採閉合導線或網形觀測，以最小二乘法平差並保存原始觀測檔；成果表需附平差報告並經測量主管簽核，未簽核的坐標不得用於放樣。~Densify control only with closed traverses or network observations, adjust by least squares and keep the raw observation files; the coordinate list must come with the adjustment report signed by the survey lead, and unsigned coordinates may not be used for set-out.

units.anchor: 樓板垂直傳遞孔~Slab transfer openings
units.title: 高層建築的軸線垂直傳遞~Vertical transfer of grid lines in tall buildings
units.mechanism: 高層建築的軸線要從地面控制逐層往上傳：常用方式是在樓板預留垂直傳遞孔，以天頂垂準儀或雷射垂準儀把地面參考點投到上層，再在上層重建軸線。樓層越高，核心筒會因日照受熱不均而彎曲、因風擺動、因自重與潛變縮短，所以量測要選在清晨溫度均勻、風小的時段；超高層更在核心筒頂部以 GNSS 搭配傾斜儀修正瞬間擺動，並依設計提供的預調量施作，而不是追求當下的絕對垂直。~Grid lines in a tall building are carried up floor by floor from ground control: transfer holes are left in the slabs and zenith or laser plummets project ground reference points to the upper floor, where the grid is re-established. The higher the building, the more the core bends from uneven solar heating, sways in wind and shortens under self-weight and creep, so observations are taken early in the morning when temperatures are even and wind is light; supertall towers also combine GNSS at the top of the core with inclinometers to correct instantaneous sway, and build to the pre-set offsets supplied by the designer rather than chasing momentary absolute verticality.
units.model: 核心筒兩側溫差造成的頂部側移 δ ≈ α·ΔT·H²/(2B)。取 α = 1.0×10⁻⁵/°C、ΔT = 5°C、高度 H = 300 m、寬度 B = 30 m：δ = 1.0×10⁻⁵×5×300²/(2×30) = 4.5/60 = 0.075 m = 75 mm。相較之下，每 30 m 接力一次、每次 ±1.5 mm 的垂準傳遞，10 次合成 √10×1.5 ≈ 4.7 mm。數值為教學假設。~Top drift from a temperature difference across the core δ ≈ α·ΔT·H²/(2B). With α = 1.0×10⁻⁵/°C, ΔT = 5°C, height H = 300 m and width B = 30 m: δ = 1.0×10⁻⁵×5×300²/(2×30) = 4.5/60 = 0.075 m = 75 mm. By comparison, plumb transfers relayed every 30 m with ±1.5 mm each combine over 10 relays to √10×1.5 ≈ 4.7 mm. Values are teaching assumptions.
units.verify: 每次傳遞後在上層以至少三個傳遞點檢查彼此的距離與角度，與地面值比較；高樓層同時以 GNSS 與傾斜儀記錄核心筒當時的偏移，換算回設計的理論位置，並定期由底層重新傳遞一次，避免接力誤差累積。~After each transfer, check distances and angles between at least three transferred points on the upper floor against their ground values; at high levels record the core's instantaneous offset with GNSS and inclinometers, convert back to the designer's theoretical position, and periodically re-transfer from the base to stop relay errors accumulating.
units.failure: 在午後日照強烈時做垂直傳遞，把核心筒暫時的熱彎曲當成施工偏差並在上層修正，第二天清晨結構回彎，軸線反而被修歪；長期只依賴下一層接力而不回到底層檢核，誤差逐層累積。~A transfer made in strong afternoon sun treats temporary thermal bending of the core as construction error and corrects it on the upper floor; the next morning the structure straightens and the grid is now wrong. Relying for months on relays from the floor below without re-checking from the base lets errors accumulate floor by floor.
units.misconception: 超高層核心筒在任何時刻都應該量測到完全垂直。~A supertall core should measure perfectly vertical at any moment.
units.practice: 垂直傳遞作業程序要規定觀測時段、風速與溫差門檻、傳遞點數量與回到底層重新傳遞的間隔；預調量由結構設計者以書面提供，測量單位不得自行決定修正量。~The vertical-transfer procedure should set observation windows, wind and temperature-difference limits, the number of transfer points and the interval for re-transferring from the base; pre-set offsets come in writing from the structural designer, and surveyors must not decide corrections on their own.

units.anchor: GNSS 靜態基線~GNSS static baselines
units.title: GNSS 靜態測量與高程換算~Static GNSS surveys and height conversion
units.mechanism: GNSS 靜態測量在多個控制點同時長時間接收衛星訊號，以載波相位解算點與點之間的基線向量，精度可達公釐級，適合建立大範圍主控制網。為了避免同一組衛星幾何與大氣狀況造成的系統誤差，重要基線要在不同日期、不同時段重複觀測。GNSS 直接得到的是橢球高 h，工程需要的是以平均海水面為基準的正高 H，兩者相差大地起伏 N，必須以大地水準面模型換算，並以精密水準檢核。~A static GNSS survey records satellite signals at several control points simultaneously for long periods and solves baseline vectors between them from carrier phase, reaching millimetre-level precision suited to large primary networks. To avoid systematic errors from one satellite geometry and atmosphere, important baselines are re-observed on different days at different times. GNSS gives ellipsoidal height h directly, whereas works need orthometric height H referred to mean sea level; the two differ by the geoid undulation N, so a geoid model is used for conversion and precise levelling for checking.
units.model: H = h − N。某點 GNSS 橢球高 h = 52.318 m、模型大地起伏 N = 21.740 m，H = 52.318 − 21.740 = 30.578 m。精密水準 2 km 閉合路線若容許 3 mm√K = 3×√2 ≈ 4.2 mm，而 GNSS 推得高程與水準相差 18 mm：雖在約 2 cm 的大地水準面模型不確定度內，仍超出水準容許值，施工高程應以水準為準。數值為教學假設。~H = h − N. With GNSS ellipsoidal height h = 52.318 m and model undulation N = 21.740 m, H = 52.318 − 21.740 = 30.578 m. If a 2 km precise-levelling loop allows 3 mm√K = 3×√2 ≈ 4.2 mm and the GNSS-derived height differs from levelling by 18 mm, it lies within a geoid-model uncertainty of about 2 cm yet beyond the levelling tolerance, so construction heights should follow levelling. Values are teaching assumptions.
units.verify: 參考 NOAA NGS-58 一類指引：每條相鄰基線至少在兩個不同日期、不同時段觀測，重複高差超過門檻就重測；網形平差時檢查基線閉合環，最後以精密水準聯測數個 GNSS 點，比較換算正高與水準高程，確認大地水準面模型在本地適用。~Following guidance such as NOAA NGS-58, observe every adjacent baseline on at least two different days at different times and re-observe when repeat height differences exceed the threshold; check baseline loop closures in the network adjustment, and finally tie several GNSS points by precise levelling to compare converted orthometric heights with levelled heights, confirming that the geoid model fits locally.
units.failure: 以單次短時間 RTK 量測建立主控制，未做重複觀測，又把橢球高直接當作正高使用，結果基地兩端的高程基準相差數十公分，排水坡度與結構標高全部出錯。~Establishing primary control from single short RTK occupations without repeats, and using ellipsoidal height directly as orthometric height, leaves the height datum at the two ends of the site tens of centimetres apart, so drainage falls and structural levels are all wrong.
units.misconception: GNSS 量到的高程就是海拔高度。~The height measured by GNSS is the height above sea level.
units.practice: 主控制網一律採靜態 GNSS 加重複觀測並與國家控制點聯測，高程以精密水準傳遞；RTK 只用於次級控制與碎部，且每天開工前先在已知點上檢核。~Establish primary control only by static GNSS with repeat sessions tied to national control points, carry heights by precise levelling, and use RTK only for secondary control and detail, checking it on a known point before each day's work.

units.anchor: 隧道貫通誤差~Tunnel breakthrough error
units.title: 長隧道貫通與誤差傳播~Long-tunnel breakthrough and error propagation
units.mechanism: 長隧道從兩端或多個工作面對向開挖，洞內只能以導線向前延伸，沒有外部檢核，誤差隨長度累積，其中方位角誤差造成的橫向偏差隨距離線性放大。因此隧道測量要先在洞口建立高精度地面網，洞內採雙重導線、以陀螺經緯儀獨立定向並定期回測，才能把貫通偏差控制在公分級。戈達基線隧道東管 2010 年貫通時橫向偏差約 8 cm、垂直約 1 cm；1990 年英法海底隧道服務隧道貫通時約偏 30 cm 與 8 cm。~A long tunnel is driven from both ends or several faces toward each other, and underground the control can only be extended by traverse with no outside check, so errors accumulate with length; lateral deviation from azimuth error grows linearly with distance. Tunnel surveys therefore begin with a high-accuracy surface network at the portals, then use double traverses underground, independent orientation by gyro-theodolite and regular re-measurement to hold the breakthrough deviation to centimetres. The east tube of the Gotthard Base Tunnel broke through in 2010 with about 8 cm lateral and 1 cm vertical deviation; the Channel Tunnel service tunnel met in 1990 about 30 cm and 8 cm apart.
units.model: 方位角誤差 σ_α 造成的橫向偏差 e = L·σ_α。開挖 10 km、σ_α = 1″ = 4.85×10⁻⁶ rad：e = 10,000×4.85×10⁻⁶ ≈ 0.049 m；σ_α = 2″ 時約 0.097 m。若每 2 km 以陀螺經緯儀獨立定向，且定向本身誤差可忽略，有效累積長度減為 2 km，1″ 對應的偏差僅約 2,000×4.85×10⁻⁶ ≈ 0.010 m。數值為教學假設。~Lateral deviation from azimuth error σ_α is e = L·σ_α. Over a 10 km drive with σ_α = 1″ = 4.85×10⁻⁶ rad, e = 10,000×4.85×10⁻⁶ ≈ 0.049 m; with σ_α = 2″ it is about 0.097 m. If a gyro-theodolite orientation every 2 km, itself of negligible error, cuts the effective accumulation length to 2 km, 1″ gives only about 2,000×4.85×10⁻⁶ ≈ 0.010 m. Values are teaching assumptions.
units.verify: 貫通前由獨立團隊沿獨立路線重測洞內控制並與施工測量比較；貫通後量測兩端導線在貫通點的坐標差與高差，與預估的貫通誤差（例如 95% 信賴的誤差橢圓）比較，並據以調整最後一段的線形。~Before breakthrough, re-survey the underground control along an independent route by an independent team and compare it with the construction survey; after breakthrough, measure the coordinate and height differences between the two traverses at the meeting point, compare them with the predicted breakthrough error (for example the 95% error ellipse), and adjust the alignment of the final section accordingly.
units.failure: 洞內導線貼近隧道壁布設，視線掠過壁面產生側向折射，誤差在每一站朝同一方向累積；沒有陀螺定向檢核時，貫通偏差可能遠大於預估，需以額外開挖或修改襯砌補救。~An underground traverse run close to the tunnel wall suffers lateral refraction as sight lines graze the wall, so errors accumulate in one direction at every station; without gyro checks the breakthrough deviation can far exceed the prediction and must be corrected by extra excavation or lining changes.
units.misconception: 隧道內導線只要每站量得夠準，就不需要獨立定向檢核。~If each underground traverse station is measured precisely enough, no independent orientation check is needed.
units.practice: 長隧道的測量設計要事先計算貫通誤差預算，規定陀螺定向間隔與獨立檢測時點；貫通前的最後檢測是保留點，須經業主的測量顧問確認後才能推進最後一段。~The survey design for a long tunnel must compute a breakthrough error budget in advance and set gyro-orientation intervals and independent check stages; the final pre-breakthrough check is a hold point that the owner's survey consultant must accept before the last section is driven.

units.anchor: 參考點穩定性檢定~Reference-point stability test
units.title: 控制網複測與移動判定~Network re-survey and movement testing
units.mechanism: 施工期間控制網本身也會變形：開挖、降水、重車與鄰近結構沉陷都可能讓控制點移動，若繼續以舊坐標放樣或監測，就會把控制點的移動誤認為結構的移動。因此控制網要定期複測，並以統計檢定區分真正的移動與量測雜訊。Crossrail 的自動化監測經驗也指出，參考稜鏡應設在影響範圍外並分散於各方向，平差不應過度修改原始觀測，以免掩蓋網形衰退。~The control network itself deforms during construction: excavation, dewatering, heavy traffic and settling neighbours can all move control points, and if set-out or monitoring continues on old coordinates, control movement is mistaken for structural movement. The network must therefore be re-surveyed periodically, with statistical tests that separate real movement from measurement noise. Crossrail's automated monitoring experience likewise found that reference prisms should sit outside the zone of influence and be spread in many directions, and that adjustments should change raw observations as little as possible so that network decay is not hidden.
units.model: 兩期坐標差 d = 4.0 mm，每期每一坐標分量標準差 σ = 1.2 mm，差值標準差 σ_d = √2×1.2 ≈ 1.7 mm，檢定量 d/σ_d = 4.0/1.7 ≈ 2.35 > 1.96，在 95% 信賴水準下判定為顯著移動；若 d = 2.0 mm，2.0/1.7 ≈ 1.18，不顯著。數值為教學假設。~Between two epochs a point differs by d = 4.0 mm with σ = 1.2 mm per coordinate component in each epoch, so σ_d = √2×1.2 ≈ 1.7 mm and the test statistic d/σ_d = 4.0/1.7 ≈ 2.35 exceeds 1.96, a significant movement at 95% confidence; with d = 2.0 mm, 2.0/1.7 ≈ 1.18 is not significant. Values are teaching assumptions.
units.verify: 依施工進度訂定複測頻率（例如每月一次，重大開挖前後加測），以相同儀器與網形重測，做自由網或以已證實穩定的點平差，逐點做顯著性檢定；判定移動的點要更新坐標並通知所有使用者，同時作廢舊坐標。~Set re-survey frequency by construction progress (for example monthly, with extra surveys before and after major excavation), re-observe with the same instruments and geometry, adjust as a free network or on proven-stable points, and test every point for significance; points found to have moved get new coordinates that are issued to every user, with the old values withdrawn.
units.failure: 監測站的參考稜鏡裝在會隨施工下沉的鄰近建物上，平差把參考點的沉陷平均分配到監測點，報表顯示軌道變位很小，實際沉陷卻被低估，警戒值觸發延遲。~Reference prisms for a monitoring station are fixed to neighbouring buildings that settle with the works; the adjustment spreads the reference settlement over the monitored points, reports show small track movements, real settlement is underestimated and alarm triggers come late.
units.misconception: 監測點的變位一定代表結構移動，與參考點無關。~Any movement of a monitored point means the structure moved, regardless of the reference points.
units.practice: 控制網複測成果要以版本編號發布並記錄生效日期，所有放樣與監測系統須在同一天切換到新版坐標；參考點的選定與更換須經監測工程師與大地工程師共同核可。~Issue re-surveyed control coordinates under a version number with an effective date, and switch every set-out and monitoring system to the new version on the same day; selection and replacement of reference points need joint approval of the monitoring engineer and the geotechnical engineer.

units.anchor: 點之記與參考框架~Point records and reference frame
units.title: 控制成果紀錄、參考框架與交接~Control records, reference frames and handover
units.mechanism: 控制網的價值會延續到營運期：竣工測量、日後擴建、結構健康監測與災後檢查都需要找到原來的點與坐標。交接時若只留下坐標表，沒有點之記、坐標系統與參考框架版本、觀測日期與平差報告，日後的人無法判斷坐標是否仍可用。台灣這類板塊活動區的地殼每年都在移動，國家坐標框架也會更新版本，所以坐標必須連同參考框架與觀測時刻一起記錄。~A control network's value lasts into operation: as-built surveys, later extensions, structural health monitoring and post-disaster inspections all need to find the original points and coordinates. If handover leaves only a coordinate list, without point descriptions, coordinate-system and reference-frame version, observation dates and adjustment reports, later users cannot judge whether the coordinates are still usable. In tectonically active regions such as Taiwan the crust moves every year and national frames are revised, so coordinates must be recorded together with their reference frame and epoch.
units.model: 兩個相距 20 km 的控制點，若相對地殼運動速率為每年 10 mm，5 年後相對位置差 10×5 = 50 mm，相當於 50 mm/20 km = 2.5 ppm 的比例差；對 500 m 的結構約為 500×2.5×10⁻⁶ = 1.25 mm，對 20 km 的線形工程則會影響各段接軌。數值為教學假設。~Two control points 20 km apart with a relative crustal velocity of 10 mm per year drift 10×5 = 50 mm apart in 5 years, a scale discrepancy of 50 mm/20 km = 2.5 ppm; for a 500 m structure that is about 500×2.5×10⁻⁶ = 1.25 mm, but across a 20 km linear work it affects how sections join. Values are teaching assumptions.
units.verify: 交接前抽查控制點是否仍存在且未受損，重測部分點並與最新成果比較；交接文件清單應包含點之記、照片、坐標與高程表、參考框架與觀測時刻、平差報告及儀器校正證書，並由業主的資產管理單位確認可讀取。~Before handover, spot-check that control points still exist undamaged, re-measure some and compare with the latest results; the handover list should include point descriptions, photographs, coordinate and height tables, reference frame and epoch, adjustment reports and instrument calibration certificates, confirmed as readable by the owner's asset-management team.
units.failure: 竣工多年後要做補強或擴建，原控制點已被鋪面覆蓋，坐標表也沒有註明參考框架版本，新團隊以新版國家坐標重新放樣，與既有結構差了數公分，接合構件無法安裝。~Years after completion a strengthening or extension project finds the original control points paved over and the coordinate list silent on the reference-frame version; the new team sets out in the revised national frame, misses the existing structure by several centimetres, and connecting members cannot be installed.
units.misconception: 坐標是永久不變的數字，只要記錄數值本身就足夠。~Coordinates are permanent numbers, so recording the values alone is enough.
units.practice: 把需長期保留的控制點納入維護管理計畫，定期巡查與保護；所有坐標成果一律註明坐標系統、參考框架、高程基準與觀測時刻，交接文件由業主的測量代表簽收。~Include long-term control points in the maintenance plan with periodic inspection and protection; label every coordinate result with coordinate system, reference frame, height datum and epoch, and have the owner's survey representative sign for the handover documents.

example: 設計練習：以極座標法從控制觀測墩放樣錨栓，控制點本身標準差 2.0 mm，全測站測距 ±(1 mm + 1 ppm)、測角 1″（4.85×10⁻⁶ rad），放樣公差 ±10 mm（95%）。距離 D = 150 m 時，測距 σ_D = 1 + 0.15 = 1.15 mm，橫向 D·σ_θ = 150×4.85×10⁻⁶ ≈ 0.73 mm，合成 σ = √(1.15² + 0.73² + 2.0²) = √5.85 ≈ 2.42 mm，95% 約 1.96×2.42 ≈ 4.7 mm，合格。D = 400 m 時 σ_D = 1.4 mm、橫向 1.94 mm，σ = √9.72 ≈ 3.12 mm，95% 約 6.1 mm，仍合格但餘裕變小，宜改由較近的控制點放樣。若忘記套用 148 ppm 的合併比例因子，400 m 的距離就多出 400×148×10⁻⁶ ≈ 59 mm 的系統誤差，遠大於所有隨機誤差的總和。數值為教學假設，不代表任何實際專案。~Design exercise: anchor bolts are set out by polar method from a control pillar whose own standard deviation is 2.0 mm, using a total station with ±(1 mm + 1 ppm) distance and 1″ (4.85×10⁻⁶ rad) angle accuracy, against a set-out tolerance of ±10 mm at 95%. At D = 150 m the distance term is σ_D = 1 + 0.15 = 1.15 mm and the lateral term D·σ_θ = 150×4.85×10⁻⁶ ≈ 0.73 mm, giving σ = √(1.15² + 0.73² + 2.0²) = √5.85 ≈ 2.42 mm and a 95% value of about 1.96×2.42 ≈ 4.7 mm, which passes. At D = 400 m, σ_D = 1.4 mm and the lateral term is 1.94 mm, so σ = √9.72 ≈ 3.12 mm and the 95% value is about 6.1 mm, still passing but with less margin, so a closer control point is preferable. Forgetting the 148 ppm combined scale factor adds a systematic error of 400×148×10⁻⁶ ≈ 59 mm at 400 m, far more than all the random errors together. Values are teaching assumptions, not any real project.
history: 最小二乘法由 Legendre 於 1805 年發表、Gauss 發展為測量平差的基礎，十九世紀的三角測量以此建立國家控制網。1950 年代電子測距儀問世，1970 年代全測站把測角、測距與記錄整合在一台儀器上；GPS 首顆衛星於 1978 年發射，1990 年代成為大範圍控制網的主力。1990 年英法海底隧道服務隧道在海底貫通，2010 年戈達基線隧道東管以公分級偏差貫通，顯示地面網、洞內導線與陀螺定向結合的成效；Crossrail 則把自動化全測站網路推到數百站的規模。本課只重建公開原理與工程邏輯，不代表任何專案的設計文件。~Legendre published the method of least squares in 1805 and Gauss developed it into the basis of survey adjustment, on which nineteenth-century triangulation built national control networks. Electronic distance measurement appeared in the 1950s, and in the 1970s total stations combined angles, distances and recording in one instrument; the first GPS satellite was launched in 1978 and by the 1990s GNSS had become the backbone of large control networks. The Channel Tunnel service tunnel broke through under the sea in 1990, and in 2010 the east tube of the Gotthard Base Tunnel broke through with centimetre-level deviation, showing the power of combining surface networks, underground traverses and gyro orientation; Crossrail then scaled automated total-station networks to hundreds of stations. This course reconstructs public principles and engineering logic only, not any project's design documents.
facts: 戈達基線隧道主隧道長約 57.09 km，最大覆蓋深度約 2,450 m~The Gotthard Base Tunnel main tunnel is about 57.09 km long with a maximum overburden of about 2,450 m
戈達基線隧道東管 Sedrun–Faido 段於 2010 年 10 月 15 日貫通，偏差約水平 8 cm、垂直 1 cm~The Gotthard east tube Sedrun–Faido section broke through on 15 October 2010 with about 8 cm horizontal and 1 cm vertical deviation
戈達基線隧道 Amsteg–Sedrun 段於 2009 年貫通，水平與垂直偏差皆小於約 1 cm~The Gotthard Amsteg–Sedrun section broke through in 2009 with horizontal and vertical deviations each under about 1 cm

英法海底隧道全長約 50.46 km，其中約 37.9 km 在海底；1990 年服務隧道貫通時約偏水平 30 cm、垂直 8 cm~The Channel Tunnel is about 50.46 km long with about 37.9 km under the sea; its service tunnel met in 1990 about 30 cm horizontally and 8 cm vertically apart

Crossrail 在自動化光學監測上投入超過 1.5 億英鎊，2014 年 4 月網路達 204 台自動全測站與 16,780 個稜鏡~Crossrail spent more than £150 million on automated optical monitoring, with 204 robotic total stations and 16,780 prisms in April 2014

Crossrail 案例的全測站測距規格為 ±(1 mm + 1 ppm)，建議觀測距離約 35 至 200 m，平差後高程多小於 1 mm~In the Crossrail case total-station distance specification was ±(1 mm + 1 ppm), the recommended range about 35 to 200 m, and adjusted heights mostly within 1 mm

NOAA NGS-58 以 95% 信賴水準訂定 2 cm 與 5 cm 兩級橢球高標準，控制站須在 3 個不同日期各觀測 5 小時~NOAA NGS-58 sets 2 cm and 5 cm ellipsoid-height standards at 95% confidence, with control stations observed for 5 hours on each of 3 different days
